manifestations.invariant: When a returned animal has a lapsed clinical vaccination, it is unavailable, the hold is reinstated, and the adoption fee is refunded exactly once.

contract_bindings.quote: Foster synchronization keeps availability unavailable while a placement is away.
Clinical vaccination history is reinstated before the adoption fee is refunded.
